remote.enabled.description: The agent runs on a different machine from your browser, so the page is served on a network address instead of 127.0.0.1

remote.host.description: The address to serve the page on: `tailscale` picks this machine's Tailscale IPv4, anything else is used as-is. Never 0.0.0.0, which exposes the Send endpoint to the whole network

remote.open.description: A shell command run with the page url as its last argument once the server is listening, e.g. `ssh -o BatchMode=yes mac open`; empty prints the url only
